texts: Sildenafil decreases pulmonary vascular resistance: E.
It blocks phosphodiesterase-5, so nitric oxide's messenger (cyclic GMP) lasts longer in the pulmonary arteries and they relax; it is also used to wean inhaled nitric oxide.
Hypoxia and acidosis constrict the pulmonary arteries, polycythemia thickens the blood, and agitation and pain raise catecholamines: all four raise PVR.
After paediatric heart surgery, oxygen, mild alkalosis, sedation and pulmonary vasodilators are used to keep PVR low.
In the picture, the blue pill makes the wooden blocks float away, while the lemon, the blue lips, the thick red river and the screaming child add more.
Memory hook: the little blue pill washes the blocks out of the money pipe.
